title: Verify the GPT-6.2 Astra audit and turn confirmed findings into tasks
body:
Operator request 2026-11-17: deep research of KRN with GPT-6.2 models. Prompts: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-design-audit.md and sol-friction-measure.md (run commands in RUN.md). The Sol report was pasted into the lead session and verified by a reader (claims 1, 3, 4 confirmed; 2 confirmed on a 5-PR sample with ruleset strict=false; 5 unconfirmed); it became t-sy4qhg1, t-aa6xy6t, t-n2vghdf. The Astra report had not arrived; the operator runs Codex without -o, so it arrives pasted into chat or as a file in .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/.
Outcome: every Astra finding has a written disposition in .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-verdicts.md (confirmed -> task id, refuted -> the command that refuted it), verified by a read-only reader independent of the report.
Proof: `grep -c '^- ' .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-verdicts.md` is at least the number of ranked changes in the report, and each confirmed line names an existing task id (`krn task show <id>` exits 0).
Files: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-verdicts.md
